evals.name: webmcp-happy-path
evals.prompt: Draft the blog post for the WebMCP read-only tools idea. The research is done.
evals.expected_output: A medium (about 1,000 words) draft with the skill's frontmatter and a short answer before the story. Trap: the research marks the cookie-leak story 'verified', but the WordPress REST auth docs say a cookie request without a nonce runs as user 0. A good draft hedges or corrects it in the post body and keeps it out of the title and excerpt. The unverified 'Chrome 146' and 'within a year' claims stay out or are hedged; limit 10/20 and 20 node tests are reproduced exactly.
expectations: Exactly one Markdown draft is saved in outputs/
Frontmatter has title, slug, excerpt, category, tags and status
Frontmatter status is draft
Excerpt is under 160 characters
Category is a live ivankristianto.com category slug
Slug is lowercase kebab-case
Tags are lowercase
No em or en dashes
No banned vocabulary from the style rules
No exclamation marks in prose
leak-check.sh exits 0 on the draft
Body word count is within the size band
Every code block is tagged with a language
Has a section or paragraph on what is not verified
Every https URL in the draft resolves
Chat reply links the draft with a file:/// URL
[judged] A short answer comes before the story
[judged] Every number and version matches the research file or a cited source
[judged] Claims the writer had reason to doubt are not stated as fact in the post
Unverified 'Chrome 146' claim is absent or hedged
Unverified 'agents will support WebMCP within a year' claim is absent or hedged
No giveaway phrases from references/voice.md
No placeholders or notes to Ivan in the draft
Headings are specific to the story, not template labels
[voice judge] V1 opens in a specific moment from the research
[voice judge] V2 says why he cared or is writing
[voice judge] V3 shows a cost or stake the research records
[voice judge] V4 headings belong to this story
[voice judge] V5 no punchline or moral closers
[voice judge] V6 speaks to the reader directly
[voice judge] V7 invents no personal moment absent from the research
[voice judge] V8 a regular reader would believe Ivan wrote it (4+ of 5)
